children: CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may retrace into a range of $13.08-1/4 to $13.11 per bushel, as suggested by a projection analysis and a rising channel.
A small three-wave cycle from $12.90-1/4 appears to have completed around a resistance at $13.34-1/2, the 100% projection level of a wave c from $13.03-3/4.
The bottom of the wave b at $13.03-3/4 serves as a target. However, the lower channel line points at a closer target range of $13.08-1/4 to $13.11.

A break above $13.22-3/4 may lead to a gain into the $13.27-1/4 to $13.30-1/2 range. On the daily chart, despite its strong momentum on Thursday, the market failed to break a resistance at $13.31-1/4.

The failure was accompanied by a fall below a rising channel. This behaviour suggests an exhaustion of the uptrend. The contract is more likely to retrace toward $12.99-1/2 than to break $13.31-1/4 and rise toward $13.51.
